$comment: retryUnstampedOnce: a prepare that ends without stamping the card for an unrecognised reason is re-dispatched once automatically; a second unstamped ending parks the card on the operator queue (needs-you) with both reasons. autoSize: a card held no-size (a task with no estimatedLoc, a story with no size) is routed to the item prepare, which authors the size/estimate from its touch set. runner: codex judges item preparation by the card file it edits; scope judges by the future implementation scope; claude always uses the Claude prepare session. mergedGuardHours: refuse a merged prepare PR while its mergedAt (falling back to closedAt, then createdAt) is within this many hours of now, regardless of dispatch history; 0 disables this merged refusal. Cascade: standard booleans true, runner codex, mergedGuardHours 24 → platform prepare → this file → env WE_PREPARE_RETRY_UNSTAMPED_ONCE / WE_PREPARE_AUTO_SIZE / WE_PREPARE_RUNNER / WE_PREPARE_MERGED_GUARD_HOURS. maxPrListingCallsPerTick: hard budget for prepare PR listing commands across settlement, prefetch and launch guards in one tick (standard 128; platform prepare, this file, then WE_PREPARE_MAX_PR_LISTING_CALLS_PER_TICK). Narrow current-id, bornAs and title queries must each be complete; budget exhaustion refuses that card. The cascade logs the value and source. launchPrListingReserve (standard 32; WE_PREPARE_LAUNCH_PR_LISTING_RESERVE): calls of that budget only the launch check may spend; settlement, prefetch and planning reads stop at max minus reserve. A launch check that still cannot list refuses (fail closed). parkedPrListingCacheMinutes (standard 15; WE_PREPARE_PARKED_PR_LISTING_CACHE_MINUTES; 0 disables): a prepare-unstamped park with no claim, live row, guard or recovery pin reuses its last complete PR listing for this long instead of re-searching every tick; a launch check never uses it. batchParallel (default true) launches fresh isolated card workers in separate lanes; batchMaxParallel (default 3) bounds fan-out by the builder external cap. Overrides: WE_PREPARE_BATCH_PARALLEL / WE_PREPARE_BATCH_MAX_PARALLEL; same cascade and source logging.
